03 · Logo

Logo variants

The full logo combines the radar icon, the wordmark and the three brand pillars (Discover, Move, Meet). Use the primary (gradient) version whenever the background is neutral enough for the colors to stand out.

Primary · on black
Mono black · on light background

Symbol only (icon)

Used as the app icon, favicon, profile avatar, or whenever there isn't room for the full wordmark.

Gradient on black
Gradient on white
